scope: static original scene terrain snapshots; actors, animation, input/controller and game behavior excluded

report.policy: No simplification, face dropping, color merging or unsupported-feature fallback

source_provenance.appearance_policy: nearest original palette color to texture RGB mean times first lightmap style mean; no runtime textures

door.appearance: explicit flat brown door color; texture mapping unsupported

pickup.appearance: original skin centroid palette sample per face; opaque flat colors

enemy.appearance: original skin centroid palette sample per face; opaque flat colors

interactive_demo.placement: demo relocates source brush/models onto imported floors near the start
interactive_demo.rules: E toggles rising door; armor once +50; enemy patrol/contact damage; F/left mouse hitscan 10 damage
interactive_demo.spawn_policy: walkable floor beyond original starting wall; world faces unchanged
